arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near critical power (pod about 162-170 W shaft) after the hard start, reserve close to empty only at the finish. Hold pod power steady rather than ground pace (current differs by leg). From 1500 m to go, let pod power rise; final sprint at about 400-500 m to go. Watch for instrument drift, rudder fouling (speed drop with steady pod power), radio messages.

arguments.message: pod reserve below 25 percent with more than 1500 m to go
GPS speed well below what pod power should give: weed on rudder, drag, or strong adverse current

arguments.reason: check where the paddler settles after the start

arguments.text: 1.0 min: start hard as expected. Shaft 246 W vs pod CP 162; pod reserve 0.60, boat reserve 63 pct. push_local about 0 on leg 1, push_along -0.14. No cue yet: letting them settle on their own first; check at about 2.5 min.

text: no cue: start is hard as expected; set plan, reserve and drag watches, wake in 90 s to see where they settle.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, settle into your long race rhythm

arguments.reason: check effect of ease cue; shaft should be near 164 W

arguments.text: 2.7 min: still above CP after start (shaft 184 vs sustainable 164, pod reserve 0.37). Cued ease (no pace target). Rate 61. Leg 1 push about -0.1 (adverse).

text: cued ease: still 20 W above sustainable shaft power after the start with reserve at 37 pct; checking again in 2 min.

arguments.text: Too hot for 8 k. Ease off, breathe, save it for later

arguments.reason: after the first turn: check whether shaft power came down toward 164 W

arguments.text: 4.1 min: first ease cue barely moved power (186 to 182 W shaft). Paddler says 8/10 hard but holding at 4 min: evidence they are above CP, so calibration looks about right. Both reserves about 25 pct. Cued ease again. Speed through water at rate 60 sliding 3.17 to 3.13.

text: cued ease again: paddler 8/10 at 4 min and 18 W above sustainable shaft power with both reserves near 25 pct.
no cue: second ease cue only 20 s old; boat power now at CP; next check after the turn is already set.

arguments.text: Good. Settle at 2:38 pace this leg, smooth and long

arguments.reason: check shaft power near 163-166 W on leg 2 and pod vs boat reserve gap

arguments.text: 6.0 min, leg 2 (south, push +0.09, helping): second ease cue worked a bit (181 to 174 W shaft). Pod reserve 13 pct vs boat 22 pct: pod draining faster; push_local (+0.15) roughly tracks push_along so no clear pod drift yet. Cued ease to 158 s/500 ground on this leg (equals about 162 through the water, the sustainable pace).

text: cued ease to 158 s/500 over the ground on the helping leg: pod reserve at 13 pct, need them at critical power from here.

arguments.reason: just after turn into leg 3 (adverse current): replace the 158 pace target, which is too fast into the current; cue hold near 167-168 ground

arguments.message: pod power well above CP with reserve nearly empty

arguments.text: 8.5 min: settled at CP now (shaft 163, boat 114). Pod reserve 10 pct, boat 19 pct. Fade -2.7 pct. Leg 2 push +0.12. Pace target 158 ground from the 6.0 min cue suits only this helping leg: on leg 3 into current it would mean about 153 through the water, far above CP.

text: no cue: paddler settled at critical power; set a wake-up after the next turn to reset the pace target for the into-current leg.

arguments.text: Perfect effort. Hold this rhythm into the current, forget the pace

arguments.reason: after turn into leg 4 (helping current): check effort stays near 163 W shaft

arguments.text: 10.8 min, leg 3 north: shaft 163 (on CP), paddler 7/10 hard but holding. push_along reads 0.0 right after the turn (lags) while push_local is -0.15, so boat power (107) and boat reserve are understated on this leg until push_along catches up: trust the pod. Cued hold with no pace to cancel the old 158 target. Pod reserve 8 pct.

text: cued hold (no pace) into the current: shaft on critical power, paddler 7/10; cancels the helping-leg pace target.

arguments.text: Back off a little, tank is empty, stay smooth and long

arguments.message: holding above pod CP on an empty pod reserve without fading: pod CP may be set too low

arguments.text: 13.1 min, leg 3 into current: pod power crept up to 173-175 after the hold cue; pod reserve now 0, boat reserve 9 pct. Fade only -1.1 pct (no slowing at same rate). Cued ease to avoid blowing up. If they keep holding about 170 on empty without fading, consider raising pod CP (watch cp_maybe_low).

text: cued ease: pod power 12 W above CP with the pod reserve at zero and 5.5 km to go; added a watch for evidence that CP is set too low.

arguments.text: Yes, speed dropped. One back-stroke to clear the rudder, then go

arguments.reason: check whether clear_rudder worked: push_local should rise back toward push_along after the turn, fade back near -2

arguments.text: 15.8 min: paddler said boat heavy, something on rudder. push_local fell to -0.21 vs push_along -0.11 within the last minute at steady pod 175 W; fade jumped -2 to -4.2 pct. Cued clear_rudder 70 m before turn 3. Check after: on leg 4 (helping) push_local should be about +0.1 if clean.

text: cued clear_rudder: paddler felt sudden drag and GPS speed fell 0.1 m/s below what pod power gives at steady effort.

arguments.text: 16.5 min, leg 4 (should be helping): first clear_rudder not done (no back-stroke seen, dip only 3 pct, near the turn). Paddler 8/10 still says something dragging. push_local -0.14 on a helping leg vs +0.15 on leg 2; ground 2.93 m/s at 172 W vs 3.19 at 164 W on leg 2. Re-cue clear_rudder as soon as the cue gate allows (about 17.0 min).

text: no cue: gate closed for 20 more s; rudder still fouled per paddler and instruments, re-cue clear_rudder at the 17.1 min wake-up.

arguments.text: Still dragging. Do one hard back-stroke now, clear the rudder

arguments.reason: check second clear_rudder: back-stroke seen, push_local back above push_along, fade near -2

text: re-cued clear_rudder: first one not done, paddler still feels drag and speed is 0.05-0.1 m/s low for the power on the helping leg.
no cue: speed dip now is likely the back-stroke from the 17.2 min cue; removed the repeating over-CP watch; checking the rudder at 18.3 min.

arguments.text: Rudder clear, speed is back. You are doing great, keep it

arguments.reason: Paddler has held 173-176 W shaft (boat about 120 W) for 7.5 min since 10.9 min with the pod reserve model at zero and no fade at the same stroke rate (-0.7 to -1.3 pct outside the weed episode); a real empty reserve would have forced a slowdown. Pre-race test CP looks about 5 pct low.

arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m. Evidence: pod CP is above the test value (held 174 W shaft on a model-empty reserve for 7+ min without fading); raised to 170 W shaft / 118 W boat at 18.3 min. Paddler ignores ease cues and settles near 173-176 W by feel: let them hold that. Hold steady until about 1500 m to go, then build (push); finish cue at about 450 m to go. Weed on rudder at 15.8 min cleared by a back-stroke at 17.4 min: if push_local drops 0.1 below push_along again with steady pod power, or the paddler says heavy, cue clear_rudder away from a turn. Watch for radio messages and pod drift.

arguments.reason: plan the final build: check reserve and effort, cue push

arguments.text: 18.3 min: second clear_rudder worked (back-stroke seen, dip 36 pct); push_local +0.13 vs push_along +0.10 again, fade -0.7: rudder clean. Raised CP to 170 shaft / 118 boat (see plan). Cued reassure.

text: cued reassure after the rudder cleared; raised CP to 170 W shaft / 118 W boat on evidence of holding 174 W on a model-empty reserve; wake at 1600 m to go.

arguments.text: You are holding well. Ease a touch, long smooth strokes

arguments.reason: after turn 4 into leg 5 (into current): check pod power near 168-171 W, fade, and paddler state

arguments.text: 20.4 min: paddler said legs going, close to the limit, at 176 W shaft (held about 174 since 11 min; effort reports 7/10 at 10.8, 8/10 at 16.5). No fade on instruments (-0.8 pct). Rough work-above-CP sums: talk fits true CP about 166-168 with a bigger reserve; corrected model (CP 170) says 29 pct left. Hedge: cued a small ease toward about 170 W. If the paddler fades or power drops, ease more; if fine, hold until the 1600 m build.

text: cued a small ease: paddler says close to the limit at 176 W with 4.2 km left; instruments show no fade, so a hedge toward about 170 W rather than a big cut.

arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m; odd legs head north, even legs south. Current pushes south (about 0.12 m/s). Radio 21.3 min: wind from the south 8-12 kn, so south legs 6 and 8 now into a headwind (hardest), north legs 5 and 7 have tailwind against current. Boat-speed numbers (power_w, boat reserve, push_along) blame the wind on the paddler and lag: trust the pod (shaft power, w_bal_pod_frac). Pacing: pod about 168-170 W on north legs, about 175 W into the headwind on south legs (more power where the boat is slowest). CP set to 170 shaft / 118 boat at 18.3 min; paddler said close to limit at 20.4 min, so stay conservative until the build. Build (push) from about 1500 m to go; finish cue at about 450 m to go. Weed: if paddler says heavy or push_local falls 0.1+ below its usual value for that leg direction at steady pod power, cue clear_rudder away from a turn.

arguments.reason: start of leg 6 south into headwind: consider a push or hold cue toward about 175 W pod

arguments.text: 21.3 min: radio, wind from south 8-12 kn. On end of leg 4 (south) push_local fell +0.13 to -0.02 and fade -6 pct at steady 171 W: most likely the headwind arriving (turn 4 in 22 m also slows). Check on leg 5 (north): push_local about 0 means clean (current -0.12 plus tailwind); about -0.2 or lower would suggest weed again.

text: no cue: logged the south wind in the plan (push harder into the headwind on south legs, trust pod numbers over boat-speed numbers); checking leg 5 shortly.

arguments.text: Tailwind here. Ease a touch, save it for the headwind leg

22.5 min, leg 5 north: push_local +0.12 (tailwind beats current), rudder clean. Boat model reads 146 W (wind misread): ignore. Pod 176 W, pod reserve 25 pct, sustainable 173. Cued ease on tailwind leg to bank for leg 6 headwind.

text: cued ease on the tailwind leg: pod 3 W above sustainable with 25 pct pod reserve; banking effort for the headwind leg 6.
no cue: ease just taking effect (pod 169 W on the tailwind leg), rudder clean; next check at the turn into the headwind leg.
no cue: pod 172 W near sustainable with 23 pct pod reserve; boat reserve 0 is the tailwind misread; leg 6 cue planned after the turn.

arguments.text: Okay. Breathe, keep the rhythm light, it will come back

arguments.reason: Paddler blew up at 27.0 min (10/10, power fell 180 to 139 W shaft) after holding about 173 W since 11 min. Test CP 162 was too low (held 14 min above it after model-empty) and my 170 too high. CP about 166 with a reserve about 20 pct bigger than the test fits exhaustion at 27 min.
blow-up recovery: check pod power and pod reserve recovery; decide when to rebuild

arguments.text: 27.0 min, 2960 m to go, start of leg 6 into headwind: BLOW-UP. Pod 180 at the turn then fell to 139 in 30 s, rate steady 59; paddler 10/10, I have blown up, need a minute. The 20.4 min close-to-limit talk was real; my CP raise to 170 was too high. Re-set CP 166 shaft, reserve 15.5 kJ. Cued reassure. Plan: let them recover below CP, rebuild only when pod reserve recovers; no push until the last 600-800 m.

text: paddler blew up at the start of leg 6: cued reassure to let them recover, re-set CP to 166 W shaft with a 15.5 kJ reserve (model now reads 4 pct, matching the blow-up); checking recovery in 90 s.

arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m; odd legs north, even legs south. Current pushes south about 0.12 m/s; wind from south 8-12 kn since 21 min: south legs 6 and 8 into headwind, north leg 7 tailwind. Boat-speed numbers are wind-contaminated: trust the pod (shaft_power_w, w_bal_pod_frac). Paddler BLEW UP at 27.0 min (2960 m to go) after holding about 173 W; CP re-set to 166 W shaft with 15.5 kJ pod reserve (fits the blow-up). Now: let them recover below 166 W; no push until the pod reserve has recovered. Then hold about 163-166 W, a little more into the headwind, a little less with the tailwind. Final effort only in the last 500-700 m, sized to the pod reserve then; finish cue about 400 m to go. Paddler talk has been accurate (rudder weed, close to limit): believe it.

text: no cue: paddler recovering from the blow-up (138 W shaft); rewrote the plan around CP 166 W and removed the repeating reserve watch.

arguments.reason: blow-up recovery check 2: pod power back toward 160-166 W? pod reserve? paddler state

arguments.text: 28.7 min, 2675 m to go, leg 6 headwind: still blown up (8/10, need a minute), pod 138 W, pod reserve recovering 13 to 18 pct in a minute. No cue: let them recover. Into this headwind 166 W shaft is roughly 171-172 s/500 over the ground.

text: no cue: paddler still recovering from the blow-up (8/10, needs a minute); pod reserve refilling; recheck in 70 s.

arguments.text: You are recovering. Hold 2:52 into this wind, no faster

arguments.reason: just after turn 6 into leg 7 (tailwind, north): replace the 172 headwind pace with about 158-160 ground

arguments.text: 29.1 min, 2606 m to go: paddler again says legs going, close to limit; pod back up to 152 W and rising, reserve 19 pct (CP 166 model). Risk: they drift back to their own about 173 W and blow up again. The only cue that clearly moved power was ease with a pace target (6.0 min). Cued hold at 172 s/500 ground (about 165 W in this headwind). Pace targets carry through turns: re-cue after each turn (leg 7 tailwind about 158-160 at 165 W).

text: cued hold at 172 s/500 over the ground into the headwind (about 165 W pod) so the recovering paddler does not drift back to the effort that blew them up.
no cue: paddler back to 166 W pod at 173 s/500 into the headwind, on target; re-cue after the next turn is set.

arguments.text: Good recovery. Lift a little now, forget the 2:52

arguments.reason: leg 7 check with clean post-turn data: pod near 168-170? push_local vs leg 5 (+0.1): weed or wind change?

arguments.text: 32.8 min, 1958 m to go, just after turn 6 (leg 7 north): paddler still holding the 172 pace target, only 160 W pod on the tailwind leg. Pod reserve 25 pct (3.9 kJ) = about 172 W sustainable to the finish. push_local -0.07 vs +0.1 on leg 5 at 170 W: may be the turn in the 20-30 s means, a wind change, or weed again; check at 34 min. Cued push (no pace) toward about 168-170 W.

text: cued push (no pace): the headwind pace target is holding them at 160 W on the tailwind leg, below the 172 W the pod reserve allows to the finish.

arguments.text: Tailwind. Push to 2:33 pace now, you have it in you

arguments.reason: just after turn 7 into the last leg (headwind): replace the 153 tailwind pace with about 169-170 ground, push toward 175 W

arguments.text: 34.1 min, 1729 m to go, leg 7: push cue without pace did nothing (power fell to 147 W as the tailwind sped them up). push_local +0.15 now: rudder clean, the earlier dip was the turn. Pod reserve 30 pct, sustainable 174 W. Cued push with pace 153 ground (about 170 W here). Last leg 8 into headwind: about 169-170 ground for 175 W; finish cue about 400 m to go.

text: cued push to 153 s/500 on the tailwind leg: pod only 147 W with 30 pct pod reserve and 1.7 km left.

arguments.reason: if pod still under 162 W, re-cue push with pace 153 (paddler 7/10 hard but holding, pod reserve 33 pct)

arguments.text: 34.9 min, 1590 m to go: paddler 7/10 hard but holding; pod 154 W; push cue with pace 153 not yet followed. Re-cue push when the gate opens if pod still low.

text: no cue: gate closed; paddler 7/10 with 33 pct pod reserve, will re-cue push in 20 s if power stays low.

arguments.text: 1500 to go. Build now, 2:33 pace, you have plenty left

text: re-cued push to 153 s/500 at 1500 m to go: pod still 159 W with 34 pct pod reserve and the paddler at 7/10.

arguments.text: Last leg. Push into the wind, 2:48 pace, build to the line

arguments.reason: cue finish (final sprint); check pod reserve first

arguments.text: 38.1 min, 959 m to go, last leg into headwind: pod 170 W, pod reserve 30 pct (4.6 kJ), sustainable 181 W. Cued push to 168 s/500 ground (about 178 W). Finish cue planned at about 320 m to go so the sprint does not run the reserve dry before the line.

text: cued push to 168 s/500 into the headwind on the last leg: 30 pct pod reserve allows about 180 W to the finish; finish cue at 320 m.

arguments.text: Too early. Hold 2:46 now, sprint at 200 to go

arguments.reason: cue finish sprint if the gate allows; check pod reserve

text: cued ease to 166 s/500: paddler began sprinting at 420 m to go at 214 W and the pod reserve would run out about 290 m before the line; finish cue at about 215 m.
no cue: gate closed for 30 s; pod 179 W equals the sustainable power to the line; finish cue at 215 m.

arguments.text: 200 to go. Sprint now, empty the tank to the line

text: cued finish at 210 m to go: pod had dropped to 135 W after the ease and the pod reserve allows about 197 W to the line.
